name: Cellular automata
doc: Life-like cellular automata (Conway, HighLife, Morley, 2x2, Day & Night, Amoeba) or continuous Lenia on a toroidal grid: onsets stamp discs of random soup, the band that rose most in the last bar (a coarse pitch class) picks the rule for the next bar (Lenia: its growth centre and width), Life steps on the beat grid; Lenia steers its population toward a territory set by the loudness and streams outward with the bass; cells are coloured by age, newborns hot, old cells cooling, dead ones leaving an afterglow.

palette.doc: the last stop for newborns, low stops for old cells and afterglow

mode.doc: Life-like rules, Lenia, or switch every phrase

bars.doc: phrase length in bars for alternate

cells.doc: grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

drive.doc: Lenia: how far the loudness of the last 2 s widens the territory and speeds the growth

seeds.doc: size of the soup discs each onset stamps (0 = none)

drift.doc: Lenia: outward stream per tick (bass speeds it up)

swirl.doc: Lenia: turn per tick, strongest at the centre

relief.doc: Lenia: emboss strength of the lighting

gap.doc: Life: dark gap between cells, share of a cell

age.doc: how fast cells cool from newborn to old colours (higher = slower)
